import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { Pienso } from 'src/app/models/pienso'; import { PiensoService } from 'src/app/services/pienso.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-categorias', templateUrl: './categorias.component.html', styleUrls: ['./categorias.component.css'] }) export class CategoriasComponent { constructor(private piensoService: PiensoService) {} filtrarPorTipo(tipoAnimal: string) { this.piensoService.getPiensosPorTipo(tipoAnimal).subscribe( piensos => { this.piensoService.piensos = piensos; } ); } }
